name: Kokuhaku no Kotoba
source:
Jun has been in love with his best friend, Kouki, for ages, but he’s never quite mustered the courage to confess his feelings Will he be able to do so today...?

[Translated from [url=https://lil-beastman.itch.io/kokuhaku-no-kotoba]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
小纯暗恋挚友光希已经很久很久了，却始终没能鼓起勇气表白心意。今天，他究竟能否把这份感情说出口……？

[译自[url=https://lil-beastman.itch.io/kokuhaku-no-kotoba]itch.io[/url]]
